project_info.color_palette: light blue, white, soft gray, and glossy silver reflections

main_subject.description: An adult woman with natural skin texture, sleek pulled-back hair, and a calm confident expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: All-white oversized hooded sweatsuit with relaxed tailoring and clean white sneakers.
main_subject.pose: Leaning casually against a giant white sneaker approximately three times her height, one hand in a pocket, relaxed weight shift, and face turned slightly toward camera.
main_subject.styling: Minimal editorial sportswear with understated polish.

composition_elements.framing: Vertical 4:5 poster with giant sneaker dominating the lower foreground and adult subject integrated at left.
composition_elements.environment: Light blue studio background with glossy reflective floor and large white STRIDE typography filling the backdrop.
composition_elements.typography: Sneaker side label STRIDE. Bottom-center italic tagline: Walk into your next chapter. Top-right small text: Designed with GPT Image 2. Render all supplied text accurately and legibly.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp sneaker leather grain and sole, adult subject, sweatsuit texture, floor reflection, and clean typography.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Bright soft commercial studio lighting with gentle shadows, clean white product highlights, and subtle reflection beneath the sneaker.

technical_specs.camera: Medium-format camera look with a 50mm lens at f/5.6, 1/200 s, ISO 100
technical_specs.quality: Photorealistic high-resolution editorial advertising, sharp product texture, clean edges, accurate typography, and polished reflective floor

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end 4:5 fashion advertisement poster. Show an adult woman with natural skin texture, sleek pulled-back hair, and calm confident expression, wearing an all-white oversized hooded sweatsuit and clean white sneakers. Have her lean casually against a giant white sneaker approximately three times her height, one hand in a pocket and weight shifted naturally. The sneaker is labeled STRIDE and dominates the lower foreground. Set the scene in a light blue studio with a glossy reflective floor and huge white STRIDE typography behind her. Add the italic bottom tagline Walk into your next chapter. and small top-right text Designed with GPT Image 2. Use soft commercial lighting, crisp leather and sole detail, accurate legible typography, and no watermark or extra text.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, explicit body measurements, illegible text, misspelled STRIDE, distorted sneaker geometry, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, flat lighting, watermark, cluttered layout

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original adult subject. Optional sweatsuit, sneaker, typography, studio, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve the product-dominant scale, relaxed pose, white styling, blue palette, and exact copy.

assets.name: giant-white-stride-sneaker
assets.usage: Replace only the sneaker silhouette, sole, leather finish, or STRIDE label while preserving the oversized foreground dominance.

assets.name: all-white-oversized-sweatsuit
assets.usage: Replace only the hoodie, pants, or shoes while preserving the clean all-white editorial styling.
